metadata.title: Tripura Tribal party shows strength in Delhi | त्रिपुरा के आदिवासियों ने दिल्ली में दम दिखाया
metadata.description: TIPRA MOTHA - A tribal organisation reached Delhi's Jantar Mantar to demand a separate state for the indigenous people of Tripura. The leader of this front is head of Royal family of Tripura Pradyut Manikya Deb Berman declared that his front will not compromise on the demand for a separate state. He also made it very clear that TIPRA will not have any pre poll alliance with any national party.
